title: $900 PS5 Pro Sells Out Amid GTA 6 Fever
description: Despite a PlayStation blackout protest, the $900 PS5 Pro is selling out in the US due to GTA 6 fever, with third-party prices hitting $1,300.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## $900 PS5 Pro Selling Out During PlayStation Blackout Amid GTA 6 Fever

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster reaches unprecedented levels, the gaming hardware market is feeling the immediate impact. According to recent reports from gaming outlet Push Square, Sony's supercharged PS5 Pro hardware model is currently selling out across the United States, driven largely by intense "GTA 6 fever."

### The Clash Between Protests and Hardware Demand

This surge in hardware demand is happening concurrently with an ongoing blackout protest taking place against PlayStation hardware. Frustrated fans have mobilized across various spaces to keep their consoles unplugged indefinitely in protest. However, the sheer gravitational pull of the PlayStation 5's most powerful model has proven too strong for many consumers.

Faced with the prospect of experiencing next-generation open-world gaming at its absolute best, a significant portion of the consumer base has prioritized securing the high-end console. The $900 MSRP hardware model has simply vanished from shelves as a result.

### Scalpers Capitalize on Shortages

As official retail channels face severe inventory depletion, opportunistic third-party sellers have stepped in to exploit the high demand. Reports indicate that scalpers on platforms like Amazon are charging as much as $1,300 for a single PS5 Pro unit. This represents a massive, staggering mark-up over the console's standard $900 retail price.

The debate surrounding hardware features—captured by the sentiment "No disc drive, no buy?"—continues among purists, yet the high pricing and rapid sell-outs demonstrate that desperate buyers are willing to pay a heavy premium to ensure they are ready when GTA 6 finally launches.

## Editor's Take

The phenomenon surrounding the PS5 Pro proves that the hype for GTA 6 can override community boycotts and hefty price tags alike. While paying a $1,300 third-party markup is hard to justify, it highlights just how powerful a single video game release can be in shifting entire hardware markets.
